children: Futures tracking the Toronto Stock Exchange edged lower on Monday following the release of CPI data.
Canada’s annual inflation was unchanged from the previous month at 3.0% in August, in line with market expectations.
Price growth remained dominated by energy goods as the war in the Middle East disrupted a key source of global oil supply.
Core inflation measures tracked by the Bank of Canada remained close to the central bank’s target.
US-listed major banks moved lower in pre-market trading amid a rebound in oil prices and expectations of a Fed rate hike on Wednesday.
Gold prices fell, putting pressure on mining shares.

title: TSX Futures Edge Lower After CPI
